text:
leah: quick FYI - saw another billing spike last night. root cause looks like a cascade: delayed enrichment -> simultaneous fanout -> ingest queue drains all at once. thinking about an API-level "lease slots" model to smooth that. thoughts?

bryan: heard about that. rough idea: give each tenant a small pool of short-lived leases that gate fanout bursts. leases expire or can be preempted by higher-SLA tenants. should reduce instantaneous fanout pressure.

priya: how do we avoid starving low-SLA tenants during steady-state? if leases are too strict we throttle normal traffic. maybe soft leases with a grace token bucket?

zach: metrics-first approach: we should baseline `instant_fanout_rate`, `lease_hit_pct`, `preemptions_per_min`, and `ingest_backlog_slope`. use those to autotune lease_count and lease_ttl.

leah: prototype config idea:
```yaml
ingest_leases:
  enabled: true
  default_lease_count: 20   # per-tenant soft leases
  lease_ttl_seconds: 30    # short-lived to avoid headroom waste
  preemption_policy: \"sla_priority\"  # allow top-tier to steal if needed
  grace_tokens: 100        # tokens consumed before hard throttle
```

bryan: preemption needs billing-key plumbing. if a tenant pays for preemptive priority, we must propagate that attribute through the enrichment path so the ingress can honor it. ties into the billing-key propagation work.

priya: also consider a cooperative client backoff hook: when server preempts, return a structured retry-with-backoff that clients (edge proxies, SDKs) can interpret to spread retries. avoids blind-spin retries causing further spikes.

zach: ops-bot suggestion: canary plan: enable leases in staging, run synthetic fanout bursts against 50 tenants (mix of SLA classes). success criteria: p95 ingest latency down 30% during bursts, reserved_headroom < 60% over 15m, and preemptions_per_min < 5. abort if steady-state p50 increases > 100ms.

leah: good. I'll add an RFC follow-up with a short simulation model (Poisson arrivals + delayed-enrichment tail). can someone own the perf harness run? @bryan

bryan: I'll take it. will add dashboards for the metrics zach listed and an alert if `lease_hit_pct` > 40% for 10m (indicates we are under-provisioning leases).

priya: one more: we need audit logs for preemptions and lease assignments for billing reconciliation. add KMS-tagged event fields so Finance can map preempted time windows to invoices.

ops-bot: note: integration ticket created - INGEST-LEASES-342. canary scheduled for us-east-2 next Tue 09:00 UTC.

leah: thanks all. I'll post the RFC link here when it's up. short follow-up to include: API error semantics for client backoff, telemetry names, and billing-event spec. :thumbsup:
